Chiang Mai

Give it three nights. Sleep inside the moat for temples on foot. Sleep in Nimman if you want coffee and a younger evening.

Old CityNimmanhaeminNorthern corridor
Get thereCNX flight about 70 minutes, SRT 9/10 sleeper about 12 hours
SplitOld City vs Nimmanhaemin
Day tripsDoi Inthanon, Chiang Rai, or a cooking class

Chiang Mai is the north. The Old City is a square moat with wat doors that still close for lunch. Nimmanhaemin is west, past Suan Dok, and is where you eat late.

Sunday Walking Street fills Ratchadamnoen. Saturday is Wua Lai, south of the moat. Both are easier if you already have a room inside or just south.

Common questions

Fly or train from Bangkok?
Fly if you land at noon and want dinner in the Old City. Take train 9 or 10 if you want a sleeper and a morning arrival at Chiang Mai station.
How many nights?
Three is the floor. Two only if you already know you will come back.
